window:theme.description: UI color theme. Options: default (dark grey + blue), midnight (deep navy), high-contrast (black + cyan), monokai (warm dark + green), nord (arctic blue-grey), dracula (purple dark), catppuccin (pastel dark + mauve), tokyo-night (blue-purple), gruvbox (retro warm + yellow), light (white + blue), catppuccin-latte (pastel light + blue), solarized-light (cream + cyan/blue), gruvbox-light (retro warm cream + orange)

network:lan_discovery.description: Enable mDNS-based discovery of other AgentMux instances on the same host and LAN. Defaults to false to avoid the Windows Firewall prompt; toggle from the HostPopover panel. See specs/lan-discovery-toggle.md.

voice:enabled.description: Globally controls whether the per-pane microphone button is rendered. Default true (absent means enabled) — set false to fully hide the buttons across all panes. See docs/specs/SPEC_VOICE_INPUT_PER_PANE_2026_05_19.md.

voice:engine.description: Speech-to-text engine. 'groq' (default, absent means groq — agentmux-srv/src/server/voice.rs's resolve_engine) sends captured audio to the hosted Groq Whisper backend; 'whisper-local' uses a local whisper.cpp binary; 'webspeech' uses the browser API (frontend-only opt-in, dev / real-Chromium only, not viable in packaged CEF builds — never reaches the backend). See docs/specs/SPEC_VOICE_STT_ENGINE_2026_06_20.md.

voice:groqApiKey.description: Groq API key for the hosted Whisper backend (voice:engine = 'groq', the default). Read server-side only, never sent to the renderer. The AGENTMUX_GROQ_API_KEY env var takes precedence.

voice:whisperCliPath.description: Path to a local whisper.cpp CLI binary (voice:engine = 'whisper-local'). Env override: AGENTMUX_WHISPER_CLI.

voice:whisperModel.description: GGML model name to auto-download on first use for the local whisper.cpp backend (default 'base.en'). Ignored when voice:whisperModelPath is set. Env override: AGENTMUX_WHISPER_MODEL.

voice:whisperModelPath.description: Explicit path to a GGML model file for the local whisper.cpp backend, skipping the auto-download. Env override: AGENTMUX_WHISPER_MODEL.

notify:sounds:enabled.description: Master enable for notification sounds. Default true. See docs/specs/SPEC_SOUND_NOTIFICATIONS_2026_06_05.md.

notify:sounds:suppresswhenfocused.description: Suppress a pane's sound when that pane is focused AND the OS window is in foreground (the user can already see the visual signal).

notify:sound:agent.turn.complete.description: Play a sound when an agent turn completes normally. Default true.

notify:sound:agent.turn.error.description: Play a sound when an agent turn ends with an error (errored, submit-timed-out). Default true.

notify:sound:agent.turn.interrupted.description: Play a sound when an agent turn is stopped or interrupted. Default true.

notify:sound:agent.message.accepted.description: Play a sound when the backend accepts a queued pending message. Default true.

notify:sound:agent.message.rejected.description: Play a sound when the backend rejects a queued pending message. Default true.

notify:sound:agent.waiting.for.input.description: Play a sound when an agent has been idle and waiting for user input for a while. Default true.

notify:sounds:waiting:volume.description: Independent gain for the waiting-for-input sound, 0.0 (silent) to 1.0. Layered below the shared master gain. Default 0.25.

notify:tooltones:enabled.description: Play a subliminal synth tone for every agent tool call. Default true. See docs/specs/SPEC_AGENT_TOOL_CALL_TONES_2026_06_05.md.

notify:tooltones:volume.description: Independent gain for tool-call tones, 0.0 (silent) to 1.0. Layered below the shared master gain — turning the master off silences both. Default 1.0.

notify:tooltones:scope.description: Which panes play tool-call tones. 'all' (default) plays for every pane in every window; 'focused' plays only for the focused pane in the focused OS window.

dnd:enabled.description: Enable drag-and-drop file attach onto an agent pane. Default true.

dnd:concurrency.description: Max number of files uploaded/attached concurrently on a multi-file drop. Absent means unlimited.

dnd:agentinserttoken.description: Insert a file-reference token into the composer on drop (in addition to attaching the file). Default true.

agent:askquestiontimeoutms.description: How long an AskUserQuestion panel waits for a human before auto-selecting the recommended option(s) and submitting, in milliseconds. Default 30000 (30s). See docs/specs/SPEC_ASK_USER_QUESTION_AUTO_TIMEOUT_2026_08_06.md §5.2.
